text: Current row CSS targets :host(:not([hidden])), expanding/expanded attributes and slot[name=content]::slotted(*). It positions content in the second grid column/row and uses inherited custom properties for spacing. Scoped CSS recommendation in this component: use the host/slot boundary and logical padding properties rather than assume ordinary descendant selectors reach slotted light DOM. The original CSS was empty; this is a current comparison and not historical reviewer feedback. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Calendar shadow styling uses host attributes and slotted selectors
